hero.title: How we use AI for our LinkedIn content
hero.subtitle: This is the internal tool KopTup uses to prepare posts about its demos: a 30-day editorial plan, posts, ad copy, carousels and screenshots. It does not post to LinkedIn: you copy the text and publish it yourself.

chips.capture: Photo and video of each demo

hero.cta: Want a content engine like this for your company? Let's talk

calendar.title: See the 30-day plan
calendar.desc: A different demo every day, with a suggested angle and format. Click a day and the generator loads that setup.

generator.title: Generate and edit the post
generator.desc: Pick a demo, angle and tone. You get a hook, body, call to action, hashtags, ad copy and a carousel, with a simulated preview.

capture.title: Add the visual
capture.desc: Create a 1200×627 image from templates or take a photo or video of the demo exactly as you see it.

0.label: Pick the day:
0.text: open the calendar and click the day; the demo and the angle are sent to the generator.

1.label: Generate and adjust:
1.text: generate with AI or with templates, try another version or change the tone, and edit what only you can add.

2.label: Check the facts:
2.text: review the alerts (unsourced figures, testimonials, links without UTM) and save the draft.

3.label: Create the visual:
3.text: download a 1200×627 template or capture the demo and use it in the preview.

4.label: Publish it yourself:
4.text: copy the text, upload the image or video to LinkedIn and post from your account. If you want paid reach, use the ad copy tab.

overview.scopeTitle: What this demo does and does not do

does.0: Generates a post, ad copy and a carousel with AI (an OpenAI model called from KopTup's server) or, when AI is not available, with local templates, and tells you which one it used.
does.1: Lets you edit the text, checks it for accuracy alerts, saves drafts in this browser and exports them to CSV.
does.2: Creates 1200×627 images from templates, downloads the carousel as a PDF and captures a photo or video of any KopTup demo.
does.3: Adds UTM parameters to links so you can measure visits in your analytics.

doesNot.0: It does not connect to your LinkedIn account or post for you (simulated in the demo; in a custom project it can connect to the LinkedIn API if your company has approved access).
doesNot.1: It does not measure reach, clicks or followers: the preview shows no real reactions.
doesNot.2: It does not make up results: the texts include no client figures or testimonials; if you add a figure, it needs a source.
